name: Joslyn Art Museum
known: The Mellon Foundation gave $400,000 in 2018 for a first curator of Native American art (The Art Newspaper).
Jack Becker, executive director, was paid $556,706 in 2024 (ProPublica).
2024 pavilion named for Tenaska (natural gas) founder Howard Hawks.

name: Palm Springs Art Museum
known: The board named Christine Vendredi executive director on 29 September 2025.
She had been interim director since April and joined as chief curator in April 2024 (Palm Springs Post, 29 September 2025).
Adam Lerner, director since summer 2021, resigned in the spring (Los Angeles Times, Christopher Knight, 10 November 2025).
The board chair is Craig Hartzman (museum website).
Sept 2024: three trustees quit over the director hire; a whistleblower alleged restricted endowment funds were misused (museum denies).
